title: Exact Symmetry as Algebra: Group-Structured Tensors that Enforce Physical Selection Rules
abstract: arXiv:2605.20440v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Symmetry determines which physical responses of molecules and crystals are allowed and underlies many models used throughout the physical sciences. Yet several widely used machine-learned models learn symmetry only approximately from data, raising the question of whether approximate symmetry is sufficient for scientific prediction. Using the Orb-v3 force field, we show that it is often not: the relaxed space group of a crystal depends on the orientation of the input for $47\%$ of a $150$-crystal subsample, and relaxation lowers the space group for half of all $399$ crystals studied. To characterize, quantify, and correct such failures, we introduce a tensor algebra, $\star_G$, defined by convolution over a finite symmetry group and applicable to tensors with noncommuting entries. We prove that the symmetry group determines the algebra's block-diagonal transform and use this structure to analyze model errors on symmetric targets

translated_title: 作为代数的精确对称性：强制执行物理选择定则的群结构张量
translated_abstract: 对称性决定了分子和晶体的哪些物理响应是允许的，并且是整个物理科学中许多模型的基础。然而，几种广泛使用的机器学习模型只能从数据中近似地学习对称性，这就提出了一个问题：近似对称是否足以用于科学预测。使用 Orb-v3 力场，我们证明通常是不够的：在一个包含150个晶体的子样本中，47%的晶体的弛豫空间群取决于输入的方向，并且在所研究的全部399个晶体中，弛豫使一半晶体的空间群降低。为了表征、量化和纠正此类失败，我们引入了一种张量代数 $\star_G$，它由有限对称群上的卷积定义，适用于具有非对易条目的张量。我们证明了对称群决定了该代数的块对角变换，并利用这一结构来分析模型在对称目标上的误差。
tldr: 提出一种由有限对称群上的卷积定义的张量代数 $\star_G$，可对非对易张量强制执行精确的物理选择定则，并揭示近似对称的机器学习力场在晶体弛豫中普遍破坏对称性的问题。
en_tdlr: We introduce a tensor algebra $\star_G$ defined by convolution over a finite symmetry group that exactly enforces physical selection rules on noncommuting tensors, revealing widespread symmetry-breaking failures in approximately symmetric machine-learned force fields.
